newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Chu Kong Ship offers 187.5 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Chu Kong Ship offers 187.5 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Shipping and transportation concern Chu Kong Shipping Development Co Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 187.5 million shares at HK$1.20 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a proforma price/earnings (P/E) multiple of 9.8 times on a fully diluted basis, the company said in a statement. Its historic P/E multiple is 8.1 times.
The IPO will run from May 13-16 and dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on May 23.
ABN AMRO Rothschild is the sponsor and lead underwriter.
The company said the proforma historic dividend yield is 3.7 percent and the proforma adjusted net tangilble asset value per share is HK$0.729.
The Hong Kong-based shipping group, which is under the supervision of the Guangdong provincial government, mainly engages in river transportation between Hong Kong and ports in the Pearl River Delta.
Chu Kong provides ship and cargo owners with a wide range of services including shipping agency, river trade cargo direct shipment and transhipment, wharf cargo handling and godown storage.
Chu Kong said about HK$50 million of the net proceeds of HK$205 million will be used to meet investment obligations of the Guangfo company.
Chu Kong has a 25 percent stake in Guangfo, which operates and manages the Guangfo Expressway in Guangdong province.

The remaining proceeds will be used to buy new tractors, trailers and two new vessels, open new agency offices in the Pearl River Delta, upgrade computer facilities, cut debt and for working capital, it said.
Chu Kong reported a profit of HK$82.99 million for the year ended in December, up from HK$60 million in 1995 and HK$58.10 million in 1994.
